summary: A file Nora builds you now has to earn being a file, not just be the same text with headers on it.
details: Several options being compared — each with a price, a rating, a time — come back as a table, not a bulleted retelling of the same sentence.
Several named places come back with an actual map, not just their addresses typed out.
limitations: This is a judgement call the builder makes each time, not a hard rule — an ordinary write-up still comes back as plain text when that's genuinely all a request needs.
